description.value: A functional magnetic resonance imaging study investigated affect regulation and the attentional-shift mechanism of painful and warm thermal stimuli in patients with borderline personality disorder and healthy control subjects.

spans.text: To investigate the potential role of self-inflicted pain as a means of affect regulation in patients with BPD, we conducted a functional magnetic resonance imaging study
